analysis.descriptor: squat cylindrical jar with a gently waisted body and rounded shoulders, bright yellow throughout. a deep yellow snap cap with softly rounded top edge covers about a quarter of the height. the front label is a tall white arch panel framed by an orange backing, holding a round yellow medallion with a blue skinned deity portrait wearing a crown, ringed by faint orange floral line art, a curved arc of small text above and two tiny ribbon banners at the sides. below sits a wide red rectangular band with bold white serif lettering, a tiny green dot square at its right, then black bold lines in two sizes. a pale embossed floral pattern rings the base.
